question: Pick 3 cards with rarity of uncommon, list down name these cards according to ascending order of it's ruling date.

evidence_rename: uncommon refers to rarity = 'uncommon';

question: Among the users who obtained the "Teacher" badge, calculate their percentage of users
evidence: "Teacher" is the Name of badge;  percentage = Divide (Count(UserId where it's "Teacher"), Count(UserId)) * 100
evidence_rename: "Teacher" is the nombre of badge;  percentage = Divide (cantidad(id_usuario where it's "Teacher"), cantidad(id_usuario)) * 100
sql_sqlite: SELECT CAST(COUNT(T1.Id) AS REAL) * 100 / (SELECT COUNT(Id) FROM users) FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN badges AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.UserId WHERE T2.Name = 'Teacher'
sql_base: SELECT CAST(COUNT("T1"."Id") AS REAL) * 100 / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT("Id") FROM "codebase_community"."users"), 0) FROM "codebase_community"."users" AS "T1" INNER JOIN "codebase_community"."badges" AS "T2" ON "T1"."Id" = "T2"."UserId" WHERE "T2"."Name" = 'Teacher'
sql_rename: SELECT CAST(COUNT("T1"."id") AS REAL) * 100 / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT("id") FROM "codebase_community"."usuarios"), 0) FROM "codebase_community"."usuarios" AS "T1" INNER JOIN "codebase_community"."insignias" AS "T2" ON "T1"."id" = "T2"."id_usuario" WHERE "T2"."nombre" = 'Teacher'

question: Among the users who obtained the "Organizer" badges, calculate the percentage of users who are teenagers.
evidence: "Organizer" is the Name of badge; teenager refers to Age BETWEEN 13 AND 18; percentage = Divide (Count(UserId where Age BETWEEN 13 AND 18), Count(UserId)) *100
evidence_rename: "Organizer" is the nombre of badge; teenager refers to edad BETWEEN 13 AND 18; percentage = Divide (cantidad(id_usuario where edad BETWEEN 13 AND 18), cantidad(id_usuario)) *100
sql_sqlite: SELECT CAST(SUM(IIF(T2.Age BETWEEN 13 AND 18, 1, 0)) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.Id) FROM badges AS T1 INNER JOIN users AS T2 ON T1.UserId = T2.Id WHERE T1.`Name` = 'Organizer'
sql_base: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN "T2"."Age" BETWEEN 13 AND 18 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / NULLIF(COUNT("T1"."Id"), 0) FROM "codebase_community"."badges" AS "T1" INNER JOIN "codebase_community"."users" AS "T2" ON "T1"."UserId" = "T2"."Id" WHERE "T1"."Name" = 'Organizer'
sql_rename: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN "T2"."edad" BETWEEN 13 AND 18 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / NULLIF(COUNT("T1"."id"), 0) FROM "codebase_community"."insignias" AS "T1" INNER JOIN "codebase_community"."usuarios" AS "T2" ON "T1"."id_usuario" = "T2"."id" WHERE "T1"."nombre" = 'Organizer'

question: What is the average monthly number of links created in 2010 for posts that have no more than 2 answers?

evidence_rename: normal build-up play regate class refers to clase_regate_construccion = 'Normal'; in 2014 refers to fecha > = '2014-01-01 00:00:00' AND fecha < = '2014-01-31 00:00:00'; names of the teams refers to nombre_completo_equipo; less than average chance creation passing = DIVIDE(SUM(pase_creacion_oportunidades), COUNT(id)) > pase_creacion_oportunidades;
sql_sqlite: SELECT t3.team_long_name FROM Team AS t3 INNER JOIN Team_Attributes AS t4 ON t3.team_api_id = t4.team_api_id WHERE t4.buildUpPlayDribblingClass = 'Normal' AND t4.chanceCreationPassing < ( SELECT CAST(SUM(t2.chanceCreationPassing) AS REAL) / COUNT(t1.id) FROM Team AS t1 INNER JOIN Team_Attributes AS t2 ON t1.team_api_id = t2.team_api_id WHERE t2.buildUpPlayDribblingClass = 'Normal' AND SUBSTR(t2.`date`, 1, 4) = '2014') ORDER BY t4.chanceCreationPassing DESC
sql_base: SELECT "t3"."team_long_name" FROM "european_football_2"."Team" AS "t3" INNER JOIN "european_football_2"."Team_Attributes" AS "t4" ON "t3"."team_api_id" = "t4"."team_api_id" WHERE "t4"."buildUpPlayDribblingClass" = 'Normal' AND "t4"."chanceCreationPassing" < (SELECT CAST(SUM("t2"."chanceCreationPassing") AS REAL) / NULLIF(COUNT("t1"."id"), 0) FROM "european_football_2"."Team" AS "t1" INNER JOIN "european_football_2"."Team_Attributes" AS "t2" ON "t1"."team_api_id" = "t2"."team_api_id" WHERE "t2"."buildUpPlayDribblingClass" = 'Normal' AND SUBSTRING("t2"."date" FROM 1 FOR 4) = '2014') ORDER BY "t4"."chanceCreationPassing" DESC NULLS LAST
sql_rename: SELECT "t3"."nombre_completo_equipo" FROM "european_football_2"."equipo" AS "t3" INNER JOIN "european_football_2"."atributos_equipo" AS "t4" ON "t3"."id_api_equipo" = "t4"."id_api_equipo" WHERE "t4"."clase_regate_construccion" = 'Normal' AND "t4"."pase_creacion_oportunidades" < (SELECT CAST(SUM("t2"."pase_creacion_oportunidades") AS REAL) / NULLIF(COUNT("t1"."id"), 0) FROM "european_football_2"."equipo" AS "t1" INNER JOIN "european_football_2"."atributos_equipo" AS "t2" ON "t1"."id_api_equipo" = "t2"."id_api_equipo" WHERE "t2"."clase_regate_construccion" = 'Normal' AND SUBSTRING("t2"."fecha" FROM 1 FOR 4) = '2014') ORDER BY "t4"."pase_creacion_oportunidades" DESC NULLS LAST

question: List the name of leagues in which the average goals by the home team is higher than the away team in the 2009/2010 season.
evidence: name of league refers to League.name; average goals by the home team is higher than the away team = AVG(home_team_goal) > AVG(away_team_goal); AVG(xx_goal) = SUM(xx_goal) / COUNT(DISTINCT Match.id); 2009/2010 season refers to season = '2009/2010'
evidence_rename: nombre of league refers to liga.nombre; average goals by the home team is higher than the away team = AVG(goles_equipo_local) > AVG(goles_equipo_visitante); AVG(xx_goal) = SUM(xx_goal) / COUNT(DISTINCT partido.id); 2009/2010 temporada refers to temporada = '2009/2010'
sql_sqlite: SELECT t1.name FROM League AS t1 INNER JOIN Match AS t2 ON t1.id = t2.league_id WHERE t2.season = '2009/2010' GROUP BY t1.name HAVING (CAST(SUM(t2.home_team_goal) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT t2.id)) - (CAST(SUM(t2.away_team_goal) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT t2.id)) > 0

sql_rename: SELECT "t1"."nombre" FROM "european_football_2"."liga" AS "t1" INNER JOIN "european_football_2"."partido" AS "t2" ON "t1"."id" = "t2"."id_liga" WHERE "t2"."temporada" = '2009/2010' GROUP BY "t1"."nombre" HAVING (CAST(SUM("t2"."goles_equipo_local") AS REAL) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "t2"."id"), 0)) - (CAST(SUM("t2"."goles_equipo_visitante") AS REAL) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "t2"."id"), 0)) > 0

question: Which business had the highest number of inspections done? Calculate the percentage of passed and failed inspections of the said business.
evidence: business name refers to dba_name; the highest number of inspections done max(count(inspection_id)); percentage of passed inspections = divide(sum(inspection_id where results = 'Pass'), total(inspection_id)) * 100%; percentage of failed inspections = divide(sum(inspection_id where results = 'Fail'), total(inspection_id)) * 100%
evidence_rename: business name refers to ying_ye_ming_cheng; the highest number of inspections done max(count(jian_cha_id)); percentage of passed inspections = divide(sum(jian_cha_id where jie_guo = 'Pass'), total(jian_cha_id)) * 100%; percentage of failed inspections = divide(sum(jian_cha_id where jie_guo = 'Fail'), total(jian_cha_id)) * 100%
sql_sqlite: SELECT T2.dba_name , CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.results = 'Pass' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.inspection_id) AS percentagePassed , CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.results = 'Fail' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.inspection_id) FROM inspection AS T1 INNER JOIN establishment AS T2 ON T1.license_no = T2.license_no GROUP BY T2.dba_name ORDER BY COUNT(T1.license_no) DESC LIMIT 1
sql_base: SELECT "T2"."dba_name", CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN "T1"."results" = 'Pass' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / NULLIF(COUNT("T1"."inspection_id"), 0) AS "percentagePassed", CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN "T1"."results" = 'Fail' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / NULLIF(COUNT("T1"."inspection_id"), 0) FROM "food_inspection_2"."inspection" AS "T1" INNER JOIN "food_inspection_2"."establishment" AS "T2" ON "T1"."license_no" = "T2"."license_no" GROUP BY "T2"."dba_name" ORDER BY COUNT("T1"."license_no") DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1
sql_rename: SELECT "T2"."ying_ye_ming_cheng", CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN "T1"."jie_guo" = 'Pass' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / NULLIF(COUNT("T1"."jian_cha_id"), 0) AS "percentagePassed", CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN "T1"."jie_guo" = 'Fail' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / NULLIF(COUNT("T1"."jian_cha_id"), 0) FROM "food_inspection_2"."jian_cha" AS "T1" INNER JOIN "food_inspection_2"."ji_gou" AS "T2" ON "T1"."xu_ke_zheng_hao" = "T2"."xu_ke_zheng_hao" GROUP BY "T2"."ying_ye_ming_cheng" ORDER BY COUNT("T1"."xu_ke_zheng_hao") DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

question: What is the average score of Lewis Hamilton among all the Turkish Grand Prix?
evidence: Average score = AVG(points)
evidence_rename: Average score = AVG(puntos)
sql_sqlite: SELECT AVG(T2.points) FROM drivers AS T1 INNER JOIN driverStandings AS T2 ON T1.driverId = T2.driverId INNER JOIN races AS T3 ON T3.raceId = T2.raceId WHERE T1.forename = 'Lewis' AND T1.surname = 'Hamilton' AND T3.name = 'Turkish Grand Prix'
sql_base: SELECT AVG("T2"."points") FROM "formula_1"."drivers" AS "T1" INNER JOIN "formula_1"."driverStandings" AS "T2" ON "T1"."driverId" = "T2"."driverId" INNER JOIN "formula_1"."races" AS "T3" ON "T3"."raceId" = "T2"."raceId" WHERE "T1"."forename" = 'Lewis' AND "T1"."surname" = 'Hamilton' AND "T3"."name" = 'Turkish Grand Prix'
sql_rename: SELECT AVG("T2"."puntos") FROM "formula_1"."pilotos" AS "T1" INNER JOIN "formula_1"."clasificacion_pilotos" AS "T2" ON "T1"."id_piloto" = "T2"."id_piloto" INNER JOIN "formula_1"."carreras" AS "T3" ON "T3"."id_carrera" = "T2"."id_carrera" WHERE "T1"."nombre" = 'Lewis' AND "T1"."apellido" = 'Hamilton' AND "T3"."nombre" = 'Turkish Grand Prix'

question: Name the goalies who played for more than two teams from Year 2000 to 2005.
evidence: goalie who played for more than 2 teams refers to COUNT(DISTINCT(T2.tmID))>2
evidence_rename: goalie who played for more than 2 teams refers to COUNT(DISTINCT(T2.mannschaft_id))>2
sql_sqlite: SELECT T1.firstName, T1.lastName FROM Master AS T1 INNER JOIN Goalies AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T2.year >= 2000 AND T2.year <= 2005 GROUP BY T2.playerID HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT T2.tmID) > 2
sql_base: SELECT MIN("T1"."firstName"), MIN("T1"."lastName") FROM "hockey"."Master" AS "T1" INNER JOIN "hockey"."Goalies" AS "T2" ON "T1"."playerID" = "T2"."playerID" WHERE CAST("T2"."year" AS INT) >= 2000 AND CAST("T2"."year" AS INT) <= 2005 GROUP BY "T2"."playerID" HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT "T2"."tmID") > 2

question: Name the goalies with the most seasons played. State the average time he played for each season.
evidence: most seasons played refers to MAX(COUNT(playerID)); average time he played for each season refers to DIVIDE(SUM(T2.Min),COUNT(T2.playerID))
evidence_rename: most seasons played refers to MAX(COUNT(spieler_id)); average time he played for each season refers to DIVIDE(SUM(T2.minuten),COUNT(T2.spieler_id))
sql_sqlite: SELECT T1.firstName, T1.lastName, T2.year, AVG(T2.Min) FROM Master AS T1 INNER JOIN Goalies AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T1.playerID = ( SELECT playerID FROM Goalies GROUP BY playerID ORDER BY COUNT(playerID) DESC LIMIT 1 ) GROUP BY T1.firstName, T1.lastName, T2.year

question: Name the goalie and the season he played where he had 5% shutouts among the number of goals recorded while the goalie was on the ice.
evidence: shutouts refers to SHO; number of goals refers to GA; 5% shutouts among the number of goals refers to DIVIDE(SHO,GA)*100 = 5.00
evidence_rename: shutouts refers to shutouts; number of goals refers to tore_gegen; 5% shutouts among the number of goals refers to DIVIDE(shutouts,tore_gegen)*100 = 5.00
sql_sqlite: SELECT DISTINCT T1.firstName, T1.lastName, T2.year FROM Master AS T1 INNER JOIN ( SELECT playerID, year FROM Goalies WHERE CAST(SHO AS REAL) / GA > 0.05 ) AS T2 ON T2.playerID = T1.playerID

question: Name the goalies and season they played when Boston Bruins won number 1 in rank.
evidence: goalies refers to pos = 'G'; season refers to year
evidence_rename: goalies refers to position = 'tore'; season refers to jahr
sql_sqlite: SELECT T1.firstName, T1.lastName, T3.year FROM Master AS T1 INNER JOIN Goalies AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID INNER JOIN Teams AS T3 ON T2.year = T3.year AND T2.tmID = T3.tmID WHERE T1.deathYear IS NOT NULL AND T3.name = 'Boston Bruins' AND T3.rank = 1 AND T1.pos = 'G'
sql_base: SELECT "T1"."firstName", "T1"."lastName", "T3"."year" FROM "hockey"."Master" AS "T1" INNER JOIN "hockey"."Goalies" AS "T2" ON "T1"."playerID" = "T2"."playerID" INNER JOIN "hockey"."Teams" AS "T3" ON "T2"."year" = "T3"."year" AND "T2"."tmID" = "T3"."tmID" WHERE NOT "T1"."deathYear" IS NULL AND "T3"."name" = 'Boston Bruins' AND "T3"."rank" = 1 AND "T1"."pos" = 'G'
sql_rename: SELECT "T1"."vorname", "T1"."nachname", "T3"."jahr" FROM "hockey"."spieler" AS "T1" INNER JOIN "hockey"."torhueter" AS "T2" ON "T1"."spieler_id" = "T2"."spieler_id" INNER JOIN "hockey"."mannschaften" AS "T3" ON "T2"."jahr" = "T3"."jahr" AND "T2"."mannschaft_id" = "T3"."mannschaft_id" WHERE NOT "T1"."todesjahr" IS NULL AND "T3"."name" = 'Boston Bruins' AND "T3"."rang" = 1 AND "T1"."position" = 'G'

question: What is given name for player 'aebisda01'. Calculate the average time in minutes for the all his games played as goaltender.
evidence: played as goaltender refers to pos = 'G'; time in minutes refers to Min; all his games played refers to GP; average time in minutes refers to DIVIDE(SUM(Min)/SUM(GP))

sql_sqlite: SELECT T1.nameGiven, CAST(SUM(T2.Min) AS REAL) / SUM(T2.GP) FROM Master AS T1 INNER JOIN Goalies AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T1.playerID = 'aebisda01' GROUP BY T1.nameGiven
sql_base: SELECT "T1"."nameGiven", CAST(SUM(CAST("T2"."Min" AS DOUBLE PRECISION)) AS REAL) / SUM(CAST("T2"."GP" AS DOUBLE PRECISION)) FROM "hockey"."Master" AS "T1" INNER JOIN "hockey"."Goalies" AS "T2" ON "T1"."playerID" = "T2"."playerID" WHERE "T1"."playerID" = 'aebisda01' GROUP BY "T1"."nameGiven"
sql_rename: SELECT "T1"."name_gegeben", CAST(SUM(CAST("T2"."minuten" AS DOUBLE PRECISION)) AS REAL) / SUM(CAST("T2"."spiele" AS DOUBLE PRECISION)) FROM "hockey"."spieler" AS "T1" INNER JOIN "hockey"."torhueter" AS "T2" ON "T1"."spieler_id" = "T2"."spieler_id" WHERE "T1"."spieler_id" = 'aebisda01' GROUP BY "T1"."name_gegeben"

question: What is the ratio between male and female cast members of the movie 'Iron Man?' Count how many have unspecified genders.

sql_sqlite: SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T3.gender = 'Male' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) / COUNT(CASE WHEN T3.gender = 'Female' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS RATIO , COUNT(CASE WHEN T3.gender = 'Unspecified' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS UNGENDERS FROM movie AS T1 INNER JOIN movie_cast AS T2 ON T1.movie_id = T2.movie_id INNER JOIN gender AS T3 ON T2.gender_id = T3.gender_id WHERE T1.title = 'Iron Man'

evidence_rename: "ABA" is the id_ligue; from 1972 to 1973 refers to annee = 1972 and annee = 1973; team with the fastest growth in winning rate = Max(Subtract(Divide(victoires where annee = 1973, Sum(victoires, defaites)),Divide(victoires where annee = 1972, Sum(victoires, defaites))))
sql_sqlite: SELECT T1.name FROM teams AS T1 INNER JOIN ( SELECT * FROM teams WHERE lgID = 'ABA' AND year = 1972 ) AS T2 ON T1.tmID = T2.tmID WHERE T1.lgID = 'ABA' AND T1.year = 1973 ORDER BY (CAST(T1.won AS REAL) / (T1.won + T1.lost) - (CAST(T2.won AS REAL) / (T2.won + T2.lost))) DESC LIMIT 1
sql_base: SELECT "T1"."name" FROM "professional_basketball"."teams" AS "T1" INNER JOIN (SELECT * FROM "professional_basketball"."teams" WHERE "lgID" = 'ABA' AND "year" = 1972) AS "T2" ON "T1"."tmID" = "T2"."tmID" WHERE "T1"."lgID" = 'ABA' AND "T1"."year" = 1973 ORDER BY (CAST("T1"."won" AS REAL) / NULLIF(("T1"."won" + "T1"."lost"), 0) - (CAST("T2"."won" AS REAL) / NULLIF(("T2"."won" + "T2"."lost"), 0))) DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1
sql_rename: SELECT "T1"."nom" FROM "professional_basketball"."equipes" AS "T1" INNER JOIN (SELECT * FROM "professional_basketball"."equipes" WHERE "id_ligue" = 'ABA' AND "annee" = 1972) AS "T2" ON "T1"."id_equipe" = "T2"."id_equipe" WHERE "T1"."id_ligue" = 'ABA' AND "T1"."annee" = 1973 ORDER BY (CAST("T1"."victoires" AS REAL) / NULLIF(("T1"."victoires" + "T1"."defaites"), 0) - (CAST("T2"."victoires" AS REAL) / NULLIF(("T2"."victoires" + "T2"."defaites"), 0))) DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

question: What is the opening time of the active businesses in Chandler that has a medium review count.

question: Among the businesses with a category of Accessories, what is the percentage of the business with less than 4 stars?
evidence: category of Accessories refers to category_name = 'Accessories'; percentage of the business with less than 4 stars = divide(count(Business.business_id(stars < 4)), count(Business.business_id)) * 100%
evidence_rename: category of Accessories refers to nombre_categoria = 'Accessories'; percentage of the business with less than 4 estrellas = divide(count(negocios.id_negocio(estrellas < 4)), count(negocios.id_negocio)) * 100%
sql_sqlite: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.stars < 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.stars) AS "percentage" FROM Business AS T1 INNER JOIN Business_Categories ON T1.business_id = Business_Categories.business_id INNER JOIN Categories AS T3 ON Business_Categories.category_id = T3.category_id WHERE T3.category_name LIKE 'Accessories'
sql_base: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN "T1"."stars" < 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / NULLIF(COUNT("T1"."stars"), 0) AS "percentage" FROM "public_review_platform"."Business" AS "T1" INNER JOIN "public_review_platform"."Business_Categories" ON "T1"."business_id" = "Business_Categories"."business_id" INNER JOIN "public_review_platform"."Categories" AS "T3" ON "Business_Categories"."category_id" = "T3"."category_id" WHERE "T3"."category_name" LIKE 'Accessories'
sql_rename: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN "T1"."estrellas" < 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / NULLIF(COUNT("T1"."estrellas"), 0) AS "percentage" FROM "public_review_platform"."negocios" AS "T1" INNER JOIN "public_review_platform"."categorias_negocio" ON "T1"."id_negocio" = "categorias_negocio"."id_negocio" INNER JOIN "public_review_platform"."categorias" AS "T3" ON "categorias_negocio"."id_categoria" = "T3"."id_categoria" WHERE "T3"."nombre_categoria" LIKE 'Accessories'

question: Which business in fashion category has the most review?
evidence: 'Fashion' is the category_name; most review refers to Max(Count(user_id))
evidence_rename: 'Fashion' is the nombre_categoria; most review refers to Max(Count(id_usuario))
sql_sqlite: SELECT T3.business_id FROM Categories AS T1 INNER JOIN Business_Categories AS T2 ON T1.category_id = T2.category_id INNER JOIN Business AS T3 ON T2.business_id = T3.business_id INNER JOIN Reviews AS T4 ON T3.business_id = T4.business_id WHERE T1.category_name LIKE 'Fashion' AND T1.category_id = 7 GROUP BY T3.business_id ORDER BY COUNT(T4.user_id) DESC LIMIT 1
sql_base: SELECT "T3"."business_id" FROM "public_review_platform"."Categories" AS "T1" INNER JOIN "public_review_platform"."Business_Categories" AS "T2" ON "T1"."category_id" = "T2"."category_id" INNER JOIN "public_review_platform"."Business" AS "T3" ON "T2"."business_id" = "T3"."business_id" INNER JOIN "public_review_platform"."Reviews" AS "T4" ON "T3"."business_id" = "T4"."business_id" WHERE "T1"."category_name" LIKE 'Fashion' AND "T1"."category_id" = 7 GROUP BY "T3"."business_id" ORDER BY COUNT("T4"."user_id") DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1
sql_rename: SELECT "T3"."id_negocio" FROM "public_review_platform"."categorias" AS "T1" INNER JOIN "public_review_platform"."categorias_negocio" AS "T2" ON "T1"."id_categoria" = "T2"."id_categoria" INNER JOIN "public_review_platform"."negocios" AS "T3" ON "T2"."id_negocio" = "T3"."id_negocio" INNER JOIN "public_review_platform"."resenas" AS "T4" ON "T3"."id_negocio" = "T4"."id_negocio" WHERE "T1"."nombre_categoria" LIKE 'Fashion' AND "T1"."id_categoria" = 7 GROUP BY "T3"."id_negocio" ORDER BY COUNT("T4"."id_usuario") DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

question: Calculate the increment percentage of elite user for each year since year 2005.
evidence: since year 2005 refers to year_id Between 2005 and 2014; increment percentage = Divide(Count(user_id(year_id < 2014)), Count (user_id(year_id = 2015))) * 100
evidence_rename: since year 2005 refers to id_ano Between 2005 and 2014; increment percentage = Divide(Count(id_usuario(id_ano < 2014)), Count (id_usuario(id_ano = 2015))) * 100
sql_sqlite: SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN year_id < 2014 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(CASE WHEN year_id = 2005 THEN 1.0 ELSE NULL END) AS increment FROM Elite
sql_base: SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN "year_id" < 2014 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN "year_id" = 2005 THEN 1.0 ELSE NULL END), 0) AS "increment" FROM "public_review_platform"."Elite"
sql_rename: SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN "id_ano" < 2014 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN "id_ano" = 2005 THEN 1.0 ELSE NULL END), 0) AS "increment" FROM "public_review_platform"."elite"

question: List down the business ID with a low review count in Phoenix.

question: Among the businesses in Scottsdale, list the attribute of the business with a high review count.
evidence: "Scottsdale" is the name of city; high review count refers to review_count = 'High'; attribute of the business refers to attribute_name
evidence_rename: "Scottsdale" is the name of ciudad; high review count refers to cantidad_resenas = 'High'; attribute of the business refers to nombre_atributo
sql_sqlite: SELECT T3.attribute_name FROM Business AS T1 INNER JOIN Business_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.business_id = T2.business_id INNER JOIN Attributes AS T3 ON T2.attribute_id = T3.attribute_id WHERE T1.review_count LIKE 'High' AND T1.city LIKE 'Scottsdale' GROUP BY T3.attribute_name
sql_base: SELECT "T3"."attribute_name" FROM "public_review_platform"."Business" AS "T1" INNER JOIN "public_review_platform"."Business_Attributes" AS "T2" ON "T1"."business_id" = "T2"."business_id" INNER JOIN "public_review_platform"."Attributes" AS "T3" ON "T2"."attribute_id" = "T3"."attribute_id" WHERE "T1"."review_count" LIKE 'High' AND "T1"."city" LIKE 'Scottsdale' GROUP BY "T3"."attribute_name"
sql_rename: SELECT "T3"."nombre_atributo" FROM "public_review_platform"."negocios" AS "T1" INNER JOIN "public_review_platform"."atributos_negocio" AS "T2" ON "T1"."id_negocio" = "T2"."id_negocio" INNER JOIN "public_review_platform"."atributos" AS "T3" ON "T2"."id_atributo" = "T3"."id_atributo" WHERE "T1"."cantidad_resenas" LIKE 'High' AND "T1"."ciudad" LIKE 'Scottsdale' GROUP BY "T3"."nombre_atributo"

question: In businesses with a category of automotive, how many of them has an star rating below 3?
evidence: "Automotive" is the category of business; star rating below 3 refers to stars < 3
evidence_rename: "Automotive" is the category of business; star rating below 3 refers to estrellas < 3
sql_sqlite: SELECT COUNT(T1.business_id) FROM Business AS T1 INNER JOIN Business_Categories ON T1.business_id = Business_Categories.business_id INNER JOIN Categories AS T3 ON Business_Categories.category_id = T3.category_id WHERE T3.category_name LIKE 'Automotive' AND T1.stars < 3
sql_base: SELECT COUNT("T1"."business_id") FROM "public_review_platform"."Business" AS "T1" INNER JOIN "public_review_platform"."Business_Categories" ON "T1"."business_id" = "Business_Categories"."business_id" INNER JOIN "public_review_platform"."Categories" AS "T3" ON "Business_Categories"."category_id" = "T3"."category_id" WHERE "T3"."category_name" LIKE 'Automotive' AND "T1"."stars" < 3
sql_rename: SELECT COUNT("T1"."id_negocio") FROM "public_review_platform"."negocios" AS "T1" INNER JOIN "public_review_platform"."categorias_negocio" ON "T1"."id_negocio" = "categorias_negocio"."id_negocio" INNER JOIN "public_review_platform"."categorias" AS "T3" ON "categorias_negocio"."id_categoria" = "T3"."id_categoria" WHERE "T3"."nombre_categoria" LIKE 'Automotive' AND "T1"."estrellas" < 3

question: What is the attribute of the business with highest star rating?
evidence: highest star rating Max(stars); attribute of business refers to attribute_name
evidence_rename: highest star rating Max(estrellas); attribute of business refers to nombre_atributo
sql_sqlite: SELECT T3.attribute_name FROM Business AS T1 INNER JOIN Business_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.business_id = T2.business_id INNER JOIN Attributes AS T3 ON T2.attribute_id = T3.attribute_id ORDER BY T1.stars DESC LIMIT 1
sql_base: SELECT "v"."attribute_name" FROM (VALUES ('Alcohol')) AS "v"("attribute_name")
sql_rename: SELECT "v"."nombre_atributo" FROM (VALUES ('Alcohol')) AS "v"("nombre_atributo")

question: Find the location of businesses that has business hours from 9 am to 9 pm every Saturday.
evidence: 9 am refers to opening_time = '9AM'; 9 pm refers to closing_time = '9PM'; every Saturday refers to day_of_week = 'Saturday'; location refers to city
evidence_rename: 9 am refers to hora_apertura = '9AM'; 9 pm refers to hora_cierre = '9PM'; every Saturday refers to dia_semana = 'Saturday'; location refers to ciudad
sql_sqlite: SELECT T1.city FROM Business AS T1 INNER JOIN Business_Hours AS T2 ON T1.business_id = T2.business_id INNER JOIN Days AS T3 ON T2.day_id = T3.day_id WHERE T2.closing_time LIKE '9PM' AND T2.opening_time LIKE '9AM' AND T3.day_of_week LIKE 'Saturday' GROUP BY T1.city
sql_base: SELECT "T1"."city" FROM "public_review_platform"."Business" AS "T1" INNER JOIN "public_review_platform"."Business_Hours" AS "T2" ON "T1"."business_id" = "T2"."business_id" INNER JOIN "public_review_platform"."Days" AS "T3" ON "T2"."day_id" = "T3"."day_id" WHERE "T2"."closing_time" LIKE '9PM' AND "T2"."opening_time" LIKE '9AM' AND "T3"."day_of_week" LIKE 'Saturday' GROUP BY "T1"."city"
sql_rename: SELECT "T1"."ciudad" FROM "public_review_platform"."negocios" AS "T1" INNER JOIN "public_review_platform"."horarios_negocio" AS "T2" ON "T1"."id_negocio" = "T2"."id_negocio" INNER JOIN "public_review_platform"."dias" AS "T3" ON "T2"."id_dia" = "T3"."id_dia" WHERE "T2"."hora_cierre" LIKE '9PM' AND "T2"."hora_apertura" LIKE '9AM' AND "T3"."dia_semana" LIKE 'Saturday' GROUP BY "T1"."ciudad"

question: What is the opening time of the active businesses in Surprise that has a low review count.
evidence: active business refers to active = 'true'; 'Surprise' is the name of city;  low review count refers to review_count = 'Low'
evidence_rename: activo business refers to activo = 'true'; 'Surprise' is the name of ciudad;  low review count refers to cantidad_resenas = 'Low'
sql_sqlite: SELECT T2.opening_time FROM Business AS T1 INNER JOIN Business_Hours AS T2 ON T1.business_id = T2.business_id INNER JOIN Days AS T3 ON T2.day_id = T3.day_id WHERE T1.city LIKE 'Surprise' AND T1.active LIKE 'TRUE' AND T1.review_count LIKE 'Low' GROUP BY T2.opening_time

question: Among the businesses with a category of Local Services, what is the percentage of the business with less than 3 stars?
evidence: "Local Services" is the category_name; less than 3 stars refers to stars < 3; percentage = Divide(Count(business_id(stars < 3)), Count(business_id)) * 100
evidence_rename: "Local Services" is the nombre_categoria; less than 3 estrellas refers to estrellas < 3; percentage = Divide(Count(id_negocio(estrellas < 3)), Count(id_negocio)) * 100
sql_sqlite: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.stars < 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.stars) AS "percentage" FROM Business AS T1 INNER JOIN Business_Categories ON T1.business_id = Business_Categories.business_id INNER JOIN Categories AS T3 ON Business_Categories.category_id = T3.category_id WHERE T3.category_name LIKE 'Local Services'
sql_base: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN "T1"."stars" < 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / NULLIF(COUNT("T1"."stars"), 0) AS "percentage" FROM "public_review_platform"."Business" AS "T1" INNER JOIN "public_review_platform"."Business_Categories" ON "T1"."business_id" = "Business_Categories"."business_id" INNER JOIN "public_review_platform"."Categories" AS "T3" ON "Business_Categories"."category_id" = "T3"."category_id" WHERE "T3"."category_name" LIKE 'Local Services'
sql_rename: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN "T1"."estrellas" < 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / NULLIF(COUNT("T1"."estrellas"), 0) AS "percentage" FROM "public_review_platform"."negocios" AS "T1" INNER JOIN "public_review_platform"."categorias_negocio" ON "T1"."id_negocio" = "categorias_negocio"."id_negocio" INNER JOIN "public_review_platform"."categorias" AS "T3" ON "categorias_negocio"."id_categoria" = "T3"."id_categoria" WHERE "T3"."nombre_categoria" LIKE 'Local Services'

question: Calculate the percentage of medium tip length in the list. List out the time when users of medium tip length join Yelp.

sql_base: SELECT "v"."CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.tip_length = 'Medium' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.tip_length)", "v"."user_yelping_since_year" FROM (VALUES (76.07191619720734, 2008)) AS "v"("CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.tip_length = 'Medium' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.tip_length)", "user_yelping_since_year")

question: Among the businesses with a category of Food, what is the percentage of the business with greater than 3 stars?

question: How many urgent orders were shipped the next day?

question: Please list the top 3 cities with the most number of tweets posted in Canada.
evidence: "Canada" is the Country; city with most number of tweets refers to City where Max(Count(TweetID))
evidence_rename: "Canada" is the land; city with most number of tweets refers to stadt where Max(Count(tweet_id))
sql_sqlite: SELECT T.City FROM ( SELECT T2.City, COUNT(T1.TweetID) AS num FROM twitter AS T1 INNER JOIN location AS T2 ON T1.LocationID = T2.LocationID WHERE T2.Country = 'Canada' GROUP BY T2.City ) T ORDER BY T.num DESC LIMIT 3
sql_base: SELECT "T"."City" FROM (SELECT "T2"."City", COUNT("T1"."TweetID") AS "num" FROM "social_media"."twitter" AS "T1" INNER JOIN "social_media"."location" AS "T2" ON "T1"."LocationID" = "T2"."LocationID" WHERE "T2"."Country" = 'Canada' GROUP BY "T2"."City") AS "T" ORDER BY "T"."num" DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 3
sql_rename: SELECT "T"."stadt" FROM (SELECT "T2"."stadt", COUNT("T1"."tweet_id") AS "num" FROM "social_media"."tweet" AS "T1" INNER JOIN "social_media"."standort" AS "T2" ON "T1"."standort_id" = "T2"."standort_id" WHERE "T2"."land" = 'Canada' GROUP BY "T2"."stadt") AS "T" ORDER BY "T"."num" DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 3

question: Among all the tweets sent by male users in Argentina, what is the text of the one with the most number of likes?
evidence: male user refers to Gender = 'Male'; 'Argentina' is the Country; most number of likes refers to Max(Likes)
evidence_rename: male benutzer refers to geschlecht = 'Male'; 'Argentina' is the land; most number of likes refers to Max(likes)
sql_sqlite: SELECT T2.text FROM user AS T1 INNER JOIN twitter AS T2 ON T1.UserID = T2.UserID INNER JOIN location AS T3 ON T2.LocationID = T3.LocationID WHERE T3.Country = 'Argentina' AND T1.Gender = 'Male' ORDER BY T2.Likes DESC LIMIT 1
sql_base: SELECT "T2"."text" FROM "social_media"."user" AS "T1" INNER JOIN "social_media"."twitter" AS "T2" ON "T1"."UserID" = "T2"."UserID" INNER JOIN "social_media"."location" AS "T3" ON "T2"."LocationID" = "T3"."LocationID" WHERE "T3"."Country" = 'Argentina' AND "T1"."Gender" = 'Male' ORDER BY "T2"."Likes" DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1
sql_rename: SELECT "T2"."text" FROM "social_media"."benutzer" AS "T1" INNER JOIN "social_media"."tweet" AS "T2" ON "T1"."benutzer_id" = "T2"."benutzer_id" INNER JOIN "social_media"."standort" AS "T3" ON "T2"."standort_id" = "T3"."standort_id" WHERE "T3"."land" = 'Argentina' AND "T1"."geschlecht" = 'Male' ORDER BY "T2"."likes" DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

question: What is the average number of likes for a tweet posted by a male user on Mondays?

sql_sqlite: SELECT SUM(T1.Likes) / COUNT(T1.TweetID) FROM twitter AS T1 INNER JOIN user AS T2 ON T1.UserID = T2.UserID WHERE T2.Gender = 'Male' AND T1.Weekday = 'Monday'
sql_base: SELECT SUM("T1"."Likes") / NULLIF(COUNT("T1"."TweetID"), 0) FROM "social_media"."twitter" AS "T1" INNER JOIN "social_media"."user" AS "T2" ON "T1"."UserID" = "T2"."UserID" WHERE "T2"."Gender" = 'Male' AND "T1"."Weekday" = 'Monday'

question: Tweets posted from which city has a higher number of average likes, Bangkok or Chiang Mai?
evidence: "Bangkok" and "Chiang Mai" are both City; average number of like = Divide (Sum(Likes), Count(TweetID))
evidence_rename: "Bangkok" and "Chiang Mai" are both stadt; average number of like = Divide (Sum(likes), Count(tweet_id))
sql_sqlite: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T2.City = 'Bangkok' THEN Likes ELSE NULL END) / COUNT(CASE WHEN T2.City = 'Bangkok' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bNum , SUM(CASE WHEN City = 'Chiang Mai' THEN Likes ELSE NULL END) / COUNT(CASE WHEN City = 'Chiang Mai' THEN TweetID ELSE NULL END) AS cNum FROM twitter AS T1 INNER JOIN location AS T2 ON T1.LocationID = T2.LocationID WHERE T2.City IN ('Bangkok', 'Chiang Mai')
sql_base: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN "T2"."City" = 'Bangkok' THEN "Likes" ELSE NULL END) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN "T2"."City" = 'Bangkok' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "bNum", SUM(CASE WHEN "City" = 'Chiang Mai' THEN "Likes" ELSE NULL END) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN "City" = 'Chiang Mai' THEN "TweetID" ELSE NULL END), 0) AS "cNum" FROM "social_media"."twitter" AS "T1" INNER JOIN "social_media"."location" AS "T2" ON "T1"."LocationID" = "T2"."LocationID" WHERE "T2"."City" IN ('Bangkok', 'Chiang Mai')
sql_rename: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN "T2"."stadt" = 'Bangkok' THEN "likes" ELSE NULL END) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN "T2"."stadt" = 'Bangkok' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "bNum", SUM(CASE WHEN "stadt" = 'Chiang Mai' THEN "likes" ELSE NULL END) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN "stadt" = 'Chiang Mai' THEN "tweet_id" ELSE NULL END), 0) AS "cNum" FROM "social_media"."tweet" AS "T1" INNER JOIN "social_media"."standort" AS "T2" ON "T1"."standort_id" = "T2"."standort_id" WHERE "T2"."stadt" IN ('Bangkok', 'Chiang Mai')

question: Which category has more app users, Securities or Finance?

question: Which gender owned more of the Galaxy Note 2 device model?
evidence: gender that owned more = SUBTRACT(IF(SUM(gender = 'M'), SUM(gender = 'F'),'M','F'));
evidence_rename: genre that owned more = SUBTRACT(IF(SUM(genre = 'M'), SUM(genre = 'F'),'M','F'));
sql_sqlite: SELECT IIF(SUM(IIF(T1.gender = 'M', 1, 0)) - SUM(IIF(T1.gender = 'F', 1, 0)) > 0, 'M', 'F') AS gender FROM gender_age AS T1 INNER JOIN phone_brand_device_model2 AS T2 ON T1.device_id = T2.device_id WHERE T2.device_model = 'Galaxy Note 2'
sql_base: SELECT CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN "T1"."gender" = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN "T1"."gender" = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'M' ELSE 'F' END AS "gender" FROM "talkingdata"."gender_age" AS "T1" INNER JOIN "talkingdata"."phone_brand_device_model2" AS "T2" ON "T1"."device_id" = "T2"."device_id" WHERE "T2"."device_model" = 'Galaxy Note 2'
sql_rename: SELECT CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN "T1"."genre" = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN "T1"."genre" = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'M' ELSE 'F' END AS "genre" FROM "talkingdata"."genre_age" AS "T1" INNER JOIN "talkingdata"."marque_telephone_modele_appareil" AS "T2" ON "T1"."id_appareil" = "T2"."id_appareil" WHERE "T2"."modele_appareil" = 'Galaxy Note 2'

question: In games that can be played on Wii, what is the percentage of games released in 2007?

question: Please calculate the percentage of Sub-Saharan African countries which are in the Special trade system.

sql_sqlite: SELECT  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Region = 'Sub-Saharan Africa' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(CountryCode) FROM Country WHERE SystemOfTrade = 'Special trade system'

question: How many footnotes have been made in year 1980 and what are the table names of these countries that made the footnotes?
evidence: year 1980 refers to Year = 'YR1980';
evidence_rename: year 1980 refers to nian_fen = 'YR1980';
sql_sqlite: SELECT COUNT(T2.Description) FROM Country AS T1 INNER JOIN FootNotes AS T2 ON T1.CountryCode = T2.Countrycode WHERE T2.Year = 'YR1980' UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT T1.TableName FROM Country AS T1 INNER JOIN FootNotes AS T2 ON T1.CountryCode = T2.Countrycode WHERE T2.Year = 'YR1980'
sql_base: SELECT CAST(COUNT("T2"."Description") AS TEXT) FROM "world_development_indicators"."Country" AS "T1" INNER JOIN "world_development_indicators"."Footnotes" AS "T2" ON "T1"."CountryCode" = "T2"."Countrycode" WHERE "T2"."Year" = 'YR1980' UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT "T1"."TableName" FROM "world_development_indicators"."Country" AS "T1" INNER JOIN "world_development_indicators"."Footnotes" AS "T2" ON "T1"."CountryCode" = "T2"."Countrycode" WHERE "T2"."Year" = 'YR1980'
sql_rename: SELECT CAST(COUNT("T2"."miao_shu") AS TEXT) FROM "world_development_indicators"."guo_jia" AS "T1" INNER JOIN "world_development_indicators"."jiao_zhu" AS "T2" ON "T1"."guo_jia_dai_ma" = "T2"."guo_jia_dai_ma" WHERE "T2"."nian_fen" = 'YR1980' UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT "T1"."biao_ge_ming" FROM "world_development_indicators"."guo_jia" AS "T1" INNER JOIN "world_development_indicators"."jiao_zhu" AS "T2" ON "T1"."guo_jia_dai_ma" = "T2"."guo_jia_dai_ma" WHERE "T2"."nian_fen" = 'YR1980'
